purpose: Empty template for independently sourced and reviewed analog-screening reference labels. Do not add labels without evidence and reviewer provenance.

label_policy.positive: A candidate meeting a predeclared, target-specific analog criterion supported by an external source or expert-reviewed evidence.
label_policy.negative: A deliberate hard negative or lookalike that fails the same predeclared criterion, with the reason and evidence recorded.
label_policy.spatial_group: A predeclared geographic/geologic block that keeps neighbouring or related windows in the same train/test partition.
